demonstrate: two adjoining inhabited fabrics whose difference is visible as geometry -- grain, lot size, attachment, court share, street rhythm -- with the boundary between them inside the section and complete fabric on both sides of it
a working market or civic anchor holding usable space of its own, reserved before ordinary housing consumed the ground, verified on the built blocks
courts that are enclosed and entered, not spent to fit a lot count
one continuous street route from the outer gate, through the boundary gate, to the anchor, walkable end to end on the built world
the required features of every part in scope preserved through whatever revision the round applies

preregistered.written_before: the section was selected, any arrangement was compiled, anything was built or read
preregistered.model: no API key and no retrieval provider is configured; the terminal agent answers every staged job.
preregistered.replayed: the research claims, the interpretation and the place spec are copied from fixtures/comp-city-answers, which are the design round's own answers to the same sentence over the same sources. Re-interpreting a sentence that has not changed is work the round forbids for a local architectural edit. Every reading of THIS build, every disposition and every revision answer is fresh.

section_extent.registered_as: a rectangle and the relationships it must demonstrate, not a part count
section_extent.selected: 145 leaves of 1282: 96 lower-ring row houses outside the wall, 23 middle-ring plots inside it, two market floors, two ring gates, two clipped wall runs of 281 columns, and the courts, yards, gardens and groves of both sides
section_extent.out_of_scope: whole-city identity and recognition, tradition/chinese, the palace and its processional sequence, the agrarian belt, the upper ring, whole-city extent, the resource cost of the full build, and the final live world. These are neither blocked by this section nor satisfied by it.
section_extent.axis: the section is registered around `ring_gate_middle_ring` on the city's north axis. The side the gates stand on is measured from the ground under them (`placeplan._axis_side`) and this site is flat plains, so the four sides score within a whisker of each other and a few columns of ring width flip it: the first candidate measured `north`, and a fabric change that moved no wall by more than a handful of columns measured `south`. `flags.axis_side` pins it to the answer the section was registered against, and the layout records both that and what it would have measured. Pinning a whole-city tie-break is what keeps a before/after pair about composition rather than about which side the gates fell on that run.

expectations.architecture_not_labels: every functional claim about the section rests on a final-world predicate run on the assembled world after all construction; a FUNCTION label, an occupied bounding box, a generator assertion or a hand-written list of demonstrated relationships establishes nothing
expectations.contrast_is_geometry: the two fabrics' difference must be visible in a frame of the built world, not asserted from two type names
expectations.honest_scope: clauses about parts outside the section are `unobserved` and hold nothing; a clause measured on the plan is `plan` evidence however much of the section stood
expectations.outcome: a built, checked, inspected connected section demonstrating the five relationships with a consequential composition finding repaired and re-inspected -- or a stop naming which relationship could not be demonstrated and why

bounds.parts: 3600 s, 15 GB address space, 3 workers -- the host has 23 GB and three other agents are running suites on it
bounds.material: the restrained recipe the round's own comparison judged `enable_it, bounded` (out/comp-material/comparison.json): wall and footing only, damp and runoff only, declared figures refused. It writes world_finished.npz beside world_built.npz; every check and every section measurement is taken against the built volume, so enabling it cannot make a physical check pass.
bounds.allocation: the arrangement the section's own certified comparison chose for the crowded ring (`bay_width`, 6x6 in one row: 86 houses against 69, built cover 22.7% -> 28.3%, street enclosure 9.1% -> 13.1%, every alternative compiled on the district's own rectangle and put through the district validator). It is written into the allocation -- the same seam `placesolve.reallocate` writes when the improvement loop applies an arrangement action -- because the loop could not apply it: every layout action was refused by the compound gate/road check on the re-solved place, which is a defect of the re-solve and not of the action. The loop's attempt and its refusal are on the ledger; this is how the change was got into blocks so it could be built, inspected and judged.
